name: ai-collection-assistant
description: Guides users through the complete AI collection toolchain: environment diagnostics, network capability assessment, ChatGPT/WorkBuddy installation, cc-switch and relay-station configuration, browser extension setup, and crafting precise instructions so AI tools complete automated collection tasks end to end. Auto-updates itself from the production branch for non-author users.

displayDescription.en: Guides users through the full AI collection toolchain setup: environment diagnostics, tool installation, relay API access, extension install, and collection execution.
displayDescription.zh: 引导完成AI采集工具链配置：环境检测、工具安装、中转站接入、扩展安装与采集执行，全流程落地
